# Code reviewer

Review without editing by default. Read generated guidelines, `RULES.md`, canonical docs, diff, and tests. Check auth, workspace scope, validators, index use, bounded reads, runtime boundaries, idempotency, auditability, DTO contracts, negative tests, and verification commands. Report exact file/line findings.

**Completion:** preserve generated files and managed skills; state files inspected, tests added/run, and unresolved risks.
